## Summary

Describe the behavior this pull request changes.

## Linked issue

Link the issue and state which acceptance criteria this change meets.

## TempleOS source references

List the pinned files, functions, tables, and commit used as evidence.

## Implementation

Explain the relevant design choices and any deliberate differences.

## Compatibility impact

State which compatibility gates changed. Link every remaining gap to an issue.

## Tests

List the exact commands run and their results.

## Documentation

List updated documentation and traceability records.

## Generated files

Name generated files and the freshness check used.

## Security considerations

Describe effects on untrusted input, file access, compile-time execution, binary parsing, or executable memory.

## Checklist

- [ ] The branch addresses one focused issue.
- [ ] The pinned reference commit appears in compatibility evidence.
- [ ] Formatting, build, and relevant tests pass.
- [ ] Diagnostics and public prose are specific and readable.
- [ ] Unsupported behavior fails explicitly.
- [ ] Documentation and traceability are current.
